mainEntity.name: What is involved in upgrading an electrical panel during a home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading an electrical panel, also known as a service upgrade, is often necessary during a home remodel, especially when adding new circuits, large appliances, or increasing overall power demand. The process involves replacing your existing panel with a new one that has a higher amperage capacity and more circuit breaker slots. This typically requires a licensed electrician to disconnect power, remove the old panel, install the new panel, and reconnect all circuits. The upgrade also includes ensuring proper grounding and bonding, and it always requires a permit and inspection by the local electrical authority in areas like Berkeley, to ensure safety and compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrading an electrical panel involves replacing the existing unit with a higher capacity one, often needed for increased power demand, and requires a permit and inspection.
